scope: Frontend-only unit board freshness, same-month stale fallback, delayed filter edits, failed next-month load, and two Chromium sign-out/sign-in cache checks
findings_resolved: Private reset now clears unit cache and increments outstanding read generation in resetPrivateSessionView, rather than only clearing loaded-month marker.
Startup now renders linked non-overview destination after sign-in even if old activeView equals destination.
limitations: Network responses are intercepted; backend persistence and permissions are not certified.
No physical-device or actual screen-reader verification.
Sign-out/sign-in cache checks cover Chromium only.
